facts:
Zochar's younger brother, Vekhal Drossyn Zochar, serves as commander of the Tsardom's Northern Vanguard, a cavalry regiment based in the tundra provinces where both brothers were born, and he has earned a reputation for leading charges that seem reckless until their tactical genius becomes apparent in the aftermath.
relationship
always

Zochar's sister, Zochar Veyla Nyessa, took holy orders after the Transformation and now serves as Abbess of the Convent of Still Waters on the shores of Lake Drenyova, where she oversees a community of nuns who tend to the spiritual needs of the owl-folk women who were most unsettled by the overnight metamorphosis of 996.
relationship
always

All three siblings — Zochar, Drossyn, and Veyla — are full-blooded Zhelvanyan owl-folk of unbroken white plumage, a rarity even in the northern provinces, and their mother was said to have wept with pride at their collective purity of lineage, which she believed marked them for greatness.
background
always
